team.name: UFlorida
team.description: UFlorida 2025 以骨转换标志物骨钙素为靶标，探索长期航天任务中的宇航员骨健康监测。团队利用 BindCraft 和基于 AlphaFold2 的计算设计生成从头设计的骨钙素结合蛋白，推进其重组表达与实验验证。长期目标是将经验证的结合蛋白集成到紧凑、非侵入式生物传感平台，实现太空中的实时骨健康监测，并进一步拓展至可穿戴或即时检测系统，以及地面的骨质疏松和其他骨健康监测场景。
team.description_en: UFlorida 2025 targeted osteocalcin, a marker of bone turnover, for astronaut bone-health monitoring during long-duration spaceflight. The team used BindCraft and AlphaFold2-based computational design to generate de novo osteocalcin-binding proteins for recombinant expression and experimental validation. Its long-term goal was to integrate a validated binder into a compact, non-invasive biosensing platform for real-time bone-health monitoring in space, with eventual translation into wearable or point-of-care systems and osteoporosis and other bone-health monitoring applications on Earth.

nodes.description: 该模块围绕骨钙素识别设计结合蛋白：利用 BindCraft 与基于 AlphaFold2 的计算设计生成候选结合蛋白，供重组表达和实验验证。后续生物传感器集成旨在把骨钙素识别转化为骨健康相关信息，形成紧凑、非侵入式实时监测平台。
nodes.description_en: This module centers on binding-protein design for osteocalcin recognition. BindCraft and AlphaFold2-based computational design generate candidate binders for recombinant expression and experimental validation. Subsequent biosensor integration is intended to translate osteocalcin recognition into bone-health information within a compact, non-invasive real-time monitoring platform.
